svg.title: Wing27 P2 / 黒地・文字のみ透光 / Black background, translucent legends only
svg.desc: 加工相談用、正面図、mm、原寸1:1。左右一体208 x 58 mm、中央切抜きなし。中央キー間92 mm。補助星印を削除、単独星印2キーは無刻印だがエンボス対象。既存Fnのみ印字。文字は乳白透光、背景と十字は遮光。Engineering review. FRONT VIEW, millimeters, 1:1. ONE continuous 208 x 58 mm overlay, NO central cutout. 92 mm inner key-edge clearance. Remove all star placeholders. Keep two blank keys as emboss regions without translucent windows. Retain the existing Fn legend only. Milky-white translucent legends; opaque black background and opaque gray cross. Emboss tooling, adhesive, ink stack and final outer contour need proof approval.
